test: Control pair: same algorithm and thresholds on two pre-flood dates
interpretation: Control candidates estimate the method's background false-alarm level when no flood is expected. This is a plausibility check, NOT an accuracy score.
limitations: Assumes no significant flooding between 2025-12-24 and 2026-01-05 (supported by ASF browse images and stable frame-wide backscatter, -0.8 dB)
Scene-relative percentile thresholds are recomputed for each pair, as in the original algorithm
Different 12-day intervals can have different weather and soil moisture
